verdict_text:
YES

The script builds the keep index exactly as specified: for each 768-wide segment it keeps head blocks 0..4 and 6..11, giving columns `0..319, 384..767` per segment (six ranges in order for the fused q|k|v weight and bias), and rows `0..319, 384..767` for the output projection. It applies this to all 12 layers, leaves every other tensor and all names untouched, asserts the four required checks before writing, and saves a single file with 160 tensors to `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
